newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takagi Sec says to post special loss.
newsitem.headline: Takagi Sec says to post special loss.

text.p: Takagi Securities Co Ltd said on Friday that it would post a special loss of 2.6 billion yen in the business year to March 31.
The medium-sized brokerage said the special loss would be the result of setting aside the same amount in loan-loss provisions to help solve bad loan problems at a financial affiliate.
Takagi said it aims to minimise the impact of the special loss on its 1996/97 earnings by posting special profits through the sale of securities.
A company official said Takagi registered a parent current loss of about 329 million yen in the first 10 months of 1996/97. It said the total for the full year was likely to be higher.
The company will revise its earnings forecast in mid-March, he said.
It previously forecast a parent current profit of 200 million yen in 1996/97, against an actual parent current loss of 439 million yen in 1995/96.
